App.description: The name and the description of the app.
App.title: App

BadgeRef.description: A field that shows as a badge.
BadgeRef.title: BadgeRef

BadgeSet.description: A label, a color, and an icon for each value of an enum field.
BadgeSet.title: BadgeSet

BadgeValue.description: The look of one enum value.
BadgeValue.title: BadgeValue

BoardColumn.description: The look of a column of a board: one enum value.
BoardColumn.title: BoardColumn

BoardView.description: Cards in columns, one column for each value of an enum field.
BoardView.title: BoardView

BooleanFilter.description: A yes or no filter on a boolean field.
BooleanFilter.title: BooleanFilter

Card.description: The content of a card in a card list or a board.
Card.title: Card

ChartWidget.description: A chart of an aggregate for each group of records.
ChartWidget.title: ChartWidget

CompareRule.description: A rule that compares two fields of the form.
CompareRule.title: CompareRule

Confirm.description: A question that the user must confirm before an action runs.
Confirm.title: Confirm

Content.description: The content region of a layout, where the page shows.
Content.title: Content

ContentOverride.description: Content keys that change on narrow screens.
ContentOverride.title: ContentOverride

Crud.description:
The parts that the CRUD shorthand of an entity asks for.

`crud: true` asks for all operations. `crud: [create, list]` asks for
some operations. The mapping form also asks for views and forms.
Crud.title: Crud

CustomAction.description: An action that hand-written code gives (a generation gap).
CustomAction.title: CustomAction

CustomRule.description: A rule that hand-written code checks (a generation gap).
CustomRule.title: CustomRule

CustomWidget.description: A widget that hand-written code gives (a generation gap).
CustomWidget.title: CustomWidget

Defaults.description: Values that apply when a UI element does not set them.
Defaults.title: Defaults

DetailHeader.description: The header of a detail view.
DetailHeader.title: DetailHeader

DetailSection.description: A card with fields of the record, or a generation gap.
DetailSection.title: DetailSection

DetailTab.description: A tab of a detail view: sections, a list of related records, or a gap.
DetailTab.title: DetailTab

DetailView.description: One record in sections and tabs. The page gives the record.
DetailView.title: DetailView

Entity.description: A kind of record that the app stores, for example a task.
Entity.title: Entity

EntityCompareRule.description: A rule that compares two fields of a record, for example `ends_at` after `starts_at`.
EntityCompareRule.title: EntityCompareRule

EntityOverlapRule.description: A rule that the time ranges of two records with the same scope do not overlap.
EntityOverlapRule.title: EntityOverlapRule

EntityUniqueRule.description: A rule that no two records have the same values in a set of fields and relations.
EntityUniqueRule.title: EntityUniqueRule

Field.description: A field of an entity, or a param of a custom operation.
Field.title: Field

FieldRules.description: Validation rules of a form field, in addition to the rules of the field type.
FieldRules.title: FieldRules

Footer.description: The optional footer region of a layout.
Footer.title: Footer

Form.description: A form that calls an operation on submit.
Form.title: Form

FormField.description: A field of a form: a field or a relation of the entity, or an operation parameter.
FormField.title: FormField

FormOnSuccess.description: What the app does after the submit succeeds.
FormOnSuccess.title: FormOnSuccess

FormSection.description: A group of form fields with a title.
FormSection.title: FormSection

Grid.description: A column grid. Forms, card lists, and dashboards use grids.
Grid.title: Grid

GridOverride.description: The columns and the gap of a grid on screens narrower than a breakpoint.
GridOverride.title: GridOverride

Layout.description: An app shell: a sidebar, a top bar, the content, and an optional footer.
Layout.title: Layout

LayoutOverride.description: The region keys of a layout on screens narrower than a breakpoint.
LayoutOverride.title: LayoutOverride

LengthRule.description: A minimum or a maximum number of characters.
LengthRule.title: LengthRule

ListWidget.description: A short list of records in a table or a card list.
ListWidget.title: ListWidget

LoadingState.description: What a view shows while it loads its data.
LoadingState.title: LoadingState

Menu.description: A navigation menu. The items without a group show before the groups.
Menu.title: Menu

MenuGroup.description: A group of menu items with a label.
MenuGroup.title: MenuGroup

MenuItem.description: An item of a menu. It opens a page, and it can have one level of sub-items.
MenuItem.title: MenuItem

MenuSubItem.description: An item below a menu item.
MenuSubItem.title: MenuSubItem

Motion.description:
The motion of the UI: the animations of charts, dialogs, menus, and transitions.

`full` keeps all animations. `reduced` stops them for users who ask
their system for reduced motion. `none` stops them for all users.
Motion.title: Motion

NumberRule.description: A minimum or a maximum value.
NumberRule.title: NumberRule

OnSuccess.description: What the app does after an action or a form succeeds.
OnSuccess.title: OnSuccess

Operation.description: An action that the app can do on an entity.
Operation.title: Operation

OperationAction.description: Run an operation, for example a delete.
OperationAction.title: OperationAction

Page.description: A screen of a front-end app.
Page.title: Page

PageArrangement.description:
Layout hints of a page: the order of its regions in a grid of columns.

The regions fill the grid in their order. Each region takes one cell,
and `content` takes a full row. A region that the list does not have
does not show, but each page shows its content.
PageArrangement.title: PageArrangement

PageContent.description: What a page shows in its layout: one view, form, or dashboard, or a gap.
PageContent.title: PageContent

PatternRule.description: A regular expression that the value must match.
PatternRule.title: PatternRule

Relation.description: A relation from one entity to another entity.
Relation.title: Relation

SearchFilter.description: A text search in one or more fields.
SearchFilter.title: SearchFilter

SelectFilter.description: A choice of enum values or related records.
SelectFilter.title: SelectFilter

Sidebar.description: The sidebar region of a layout.
Sidebar.title: Sidebar

SidebarOverride.description: Sidebar keys that change on narrow screens.
SidebarOverride.title: SidebarOverride

StatWidget.description: A stat tile: a count or another aggregate of records.
StatWidget.title: StatWidget

State.description: What a view shows in a state: a title, a text, an icon, and an action.
State.title: State

States.description: The loading, empty, and error states of a view.
States.title: States

Theme.description: The theme settings of the app.
Theme.title: Theme

Token.description: A design token: a named value, with an optional value for each mode.
Token.title: Token

TokenGroup.description: A group of tokens and groups. The keys that do not start with `$` are names.
TokenGroup.title: TokenGroup

Tokens.description: The design tokens of the app: one group for each kind of token.
Tokens.title: Tokens

Topbar.description: The top bar region of a layout.
Topbar.title: Topbar

TopbarOverride.description: Top bar keys that change on narrow screens.
TopbarOverride.title: TopbarOverride

UI.description: The `ui` section: the design tokens and the UI elements of the app.
UI.title: UI

ViewResponsive.description: How a view shows on screens narrower than a breakpoint.
ViewResponsive.title: ViewResponsive

title: appgen app definition
